name: Horizon
description: A synthwave dashboard: neon panels over a dusk sky, a striped setting sun, wireframe mountains and a grid floor that runs to the horizon, in a dusk dark theme and a daybreak light one. A menu grouped by task for any number of cars, the map as the hero and the same pages as Instrument. Works from a phone to a native 4K screen, with an Interface size setting. Runs on /api/v1.
author: Sentry Mate
